targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour',timestamp) AS time, count(*) AS queries FROM query_logs GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT round(avg((judge_relevance+judge_accuracy+judge_completeness)::numeric/3),2) AS score FROM query_logs WHERE judge_relevance IS NOT NULL
SELECT round(100.0*sum(CASE WHEN user_feedback=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(count(user_feedback),0),1) AS pct FROM query_logs WHERE user_feedback IS NOT NULL

SELECT 'rewrite' AS stage,avg(rewrite_ms)::int AS ms FROM query_logs UNION ALL SELECT 'retrieval',avg(retrieval_ms)::int FROM query_logs UNION ALL SELECT 'reranker',avg(reranker_ms)::int FROM query_logs UNION ALL SELECT 'generation',avg(generation_ms)::int FROM query_logs UNION ALL SELECT 'judge',avg(judge_ms)::int FROM query_logs
SELECT timestamp,left(question,80) AS question,judge_relevance,judge_accuracy,judge_completeness,total_ms FROM query_logs ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT unnest(rewritten_queries) AS tag_word, count(*) AS occurrences FROM query_logs GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20
